announcements.title: SALAT: Salat in Congregation
announcements.content:
Anas ibne-Malik Radiyallahu 'anhu narrates that Rasulullah Sallallahu 'alaihi wasalaam said: A Du'a made between the Adhan and the Iqamah is never rejected. The Sahaba asked: What Du'a should we make, O Rasuallah? He replied: Ask Allah for 'Afiyah (well being) in this world and in the Hereafter.
(Tirmidhi)

announcements.title: SALAT: Deeds and virtues of the Masjid
announcements.content:
Abu Sa'id Kudhri Radiyallahu 'anhu narrates that Rasulullah Sallallahu 'alaihi wasalaam said: 
Whoever loves the masjid, Allah loves him,
(Tabarani, Majma'uz-Zawaid)
